invariants_created: PASS must be sent after USER command for authentication
Data transfer commands (LIST, RETR, STOR, NLST) require successful authentication (USER/PASS) before execution
PASV or PORT should be sent before data transfer commands to establish data connection
QUIT can be sent from any state to terminate session
After authentication failure, user may retry with USER command
RNTO must follow RNFR command for rename operations
Initial server greeting (220) is received before any client commands
TYPE command can be sent after authentication to set transfer mode before data transfers
FEAT command is typically sent after authentication to discover server capabilities
PORT.format: Must contain exactly 6 comma-separated numeric values: h1,h2,h3,h4,p1,p2 representing IP address and port
TYPE.type: Must be 'A' for ASCII or 'I' for binary/image transfer
USER.username: Must be a non-empty string identifying the user account
PASS.password: Must be provided after USER command for authentication
CWD.path: Must specify a valid directory path on the server
RETR.filename: Must specify an existing filename accessible to the authenticated user
STOR.filename: Must specify a filename for the file to be uploaded
RNFR.pathname: Must specify an existing file or directory to be renamed
RNTO.pathname: Must specify the new name for the file/directory identified by preceding RNFR
MKD.pathname: Must specify a directory name that does not already exist
DELE.filename: Must specify an existing file to be deleted
RMD.pathname: Must specify an existing empty directory to be removed
